lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期六我哥哥要開車去海邊釣魚，你要不要跟我們一起去？
lines.simplified: 这个星期六我哥哥要开车去海边钓鱼，你要不要跟我们一起去？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǒ gēge yào kāichē qù hǎibiān diàoyú, nǐ yào bú yào gēn wǒmen yìqǐ qù?
lines.english: This Saturday my older brother is driving to the seaside to go fishing. Do you want to come with us?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 去倒是想去，可是我星期六早上要去補習班上課，十二點才下課。
lines.simplified: 去倒是想去，可是我星期六早上要去补习班上课，十二点才下课。
lines.pinyin: Qù dàoshì xiǎng qù, kěshì wǒ xīngqíliù zǎoshàng yào qù bǔxíbān shàngkè, shí'èr diǎn cái xiàkè.
lines.english: I do want to go, but on Saturday morning I have a class at cram school, and it only ends at twelve.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們打算八點就出發。我問問我哥哥，看能不能晚一點走。
lines.simplified: 我们打算八点就出发。我问问我哥哥，看能不能晚一点走。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn bā diǎn jiù chūfā. Wǒ wènwen wǒ gēge, kàn néng bù néng wǎn yìdiǎn zǒu.
lines.english: We're planning to leave at eight. I'll ask my brother whether we can leave a bit later.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不用麻煩他了。我下課以後自己坐火車過去，下午就到了。
lines.simplified: 不用麻烦他了。我下课以后自己坐火车过去，下午就到了。
lines.pinyin: Búyòng máfán tā le. Wǒ xiàkè yǐhòu zìjǐ zuò huǒchē guòqù, xiàwǔ jiù dào le.
lines.english: No need to trouble him. After class I'll take the train there myself and arrive in the afternoon.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的星期六會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的星期六会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xīngqíliù huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the man do on Saturday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Set off with them in the morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下課以後再跟他們一起開車去
choices.simplified: 下课以后再跟他们一起开车去
choices.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu zài gēn tāmen yìqǐ kāichē qù.
choices.english: Drive there with them after his class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiàkè hòu yí ge rén dā chē qù.
choices.english: Go there alone by train after class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi yào shàngkè jiù bú qù le.
choices.english: Not go, because he has class.

questions.why: 去倒是想去，可是…… means he does want to go, and he turns down the offer to wait (不用麻煩他了): he takes the train alone after class. Waiting for him was only the woman's idea.

focus.en: yes, I do want to, but…

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 學校旁邊新開的室內游泳池，你去過了嗎？
lines.simplified: 学校旁边新开的室内游泳池，你去过了吗？
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào pángbiān xīn kāi de shìnèi yóuyǒngchí, nǐ qù guo le ma?
lines.english: Have you been to the new indoor pool next to school?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 去過了。地方大是很大，不過人太多了，游泳的時候常常碰到別人。
lines.simplified: 去过了。地方大是很大，不过人太多了，游泳的时候常常碰到别人。
lines.pinyin: Qù guo le. Dìfāng dà shì hěn dà, búguò rén tài duō le, yóuyǒng de shíhòu chángcháng pèngdào biérén.
lines.english: I have. It's big, all right, but there are far too many people: you keep bumping into people while you swim.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那早上去呢？早上七點人應該比較少吧？
lines.simplified: 那早上去呢？早上七点人应该比较少吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà zǎoshàng qù ne? Zǎoshàng qī diǎn rén yīnggāi bǐjiào shǎo ba?
lines.english: What about the morning? There should be fewer people at seven, right?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我就是七點去的，也一樣。要去的話，就晚上九點以後吧。
lines.simplified: 我就是七点去的，也一样。要去的话，就晚上九点以后吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiù shì qī diǎn qù de, yě yíyàng. Yào qù de huà, jiù wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu ba.
lines.english: Seven is when I went: same thing. If you go, go after nine in the evening.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得那個游泳池怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得那个游泳池怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde nàge yóuyǒngchí zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of that pool?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìfāng dà, zhǐshì tài jǐ le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Rén bù duō, zhǐshì yǒudiǎn xiǎo.
choices.english: It's not crowded, only a bit small.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìfāng dà, zǎoshàng rén yě shǎo.
choices.english: It's big, and quiet in the morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn xīn, zhǐshì wǎnshàng rén duō.
choices.english: It's new, only crowded in the evening.

questions.why: 地方大是很大，不過人太多了: X 是 X + 不過 grants a point (it is big), then gives the real view (too crowded). The quiet morning was only her guess (也一樣), and the evening is his tip, not a complaint.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們不是說好下個月一起騎腳踏車環島嗎？妳怎麼還沒開始準備？
lines.simplified: 我们不是说好下个月一起骑脚踏车环岛吗？你怎么还没开始准备？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen bú shì shuō hǎo xià ge yuè yìqǐ qí jiǎotàchē huándǎo ma? Nǐ zěnme hái méi kāishǐ zhǔnbèi?
lines.english: Didn't we agree to cycle around the island together next month? Why haven't you started getting ready?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我的腳上個週末打球受傷了，醫生說這兩個月最好別做太累的運動。
lines.simplified: 我的脚上个周末打球受伤了，医生说这两个月最好别做太累的运动。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎo shàng ge zhōumò dǎ qiú shòushāng le, yīshēng shuō zhè liǎng ge yuè zuì hǎo bié zuò tài lèi de yùndòng.
lines.english: I hurt my foot playing ball last weekend. The doctor says I had better not do tiring exercise for the next two months.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 既然這樣，我們就改坐火車環島吧，時間不用改，一樣能去很多地方。
lines.simplified: 既然这样，我们就改坐火车环岛吧，时间不用改，一样能去很多地方。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhèyàng, wǒmen jiù gǎi zuò huǒchē huándǎo ba, shíjiān búyòng gǎi, yíyàng néng qù hěn duō dìfāng.
lines.english: In that case, let's go around the island by train instead. The dates can stay, and we can still go to lots of places.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好主意！那我今天就上網看看火車票。
lines.simplified: 好主意！那我今天就上网看看火车票。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyì! Nà wǒ jīntiān jiù shàngwǎng kànkan huǒchē piào.
lines.english: Good idea! Then I'll look at train tickets online today.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng liǎng ge yuè zài qí chē qù.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè dā huǒchē qù.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng ge yuè hòu dā huǒchē qù.
choices.english: Go by train in two months.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè háishì qí chē qù.

questions.why: 既然這樣，我們就改坐火車環島吧，時間不用改: since she can't do tiring exercise, they change how they travel, not when. Two months is how long her foot needs, not when they leave.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我本來想請你這個星期六來我家吃飯，可是我阿姨那天要從美國回來。
lines.simplified: 我本来想请你这个星期六来我家吃饭，可是我阿姨那天要从美国回来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qǐng nǐ zhège xīngqíliù lái wǒ jiā chīfàn, kěshì wǒ āyí nà tiān yào cóng Měiguó huílái.
lines.english: I was going to invite you to dinner at my place this Saturday, but my aunt is coming back from the US that day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒關係啊，那就跟阿姨一起吃嘛，人多比較熱鬧。
lines.simplified: 没关系啊，那就跟阿姨一起吃嘛，人多比较热闹。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi a, nà jiù gēn āyí yìqǐ chī ma, rén duō bǐjiào rènào.
lines.english: That's fine, then let's just eat with your aunt. More people is more fun.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是她要坐十幾個小時的飛機，到了應該會很累。
lines.simplified: 可是她要坐十几个小时的飞机，到了应该会很累。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì tā yào zuò shíjǐ ge xiǎoshí de fēijī, dào le yīnggāi huì hěn lèi.
lines.english: But she'll be on a plane for over ten hours. She'll probably be very tired when she arrives.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 既然這樣，就讓她好好休息吧，我們兩個下個星期六再吃。
lines.simplified: 既然这样，就让她好好休息吧，我们两个下个星期六再吃。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhèyàng, jiù ràng tā hǎohǎo xiūxí ba, wǒmen liǎng ge xià ge xīngqíliù zài chī.
lines.english: In that case, let her rest properly. The two of us will have dinner next Saturday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 這個星期六三個人一起吃
choices.simplified: 这个星期六三个人一起吃
choices.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù sān ge rén yìqǐ chī.
choices.english: The three of them eat together this Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期六陪阿姨去外面吃
choices.simplified: 星期六陪阿姨去外面吃
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù péi āyí qù wàimiàn chī.
choices.english: Take the aunt out to eat on Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下個星期六跟阿姨一起吃
choices.simplified: 下个星期六跟阿姨一起吃
choices.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqíliù gēn āyí yìqǐ chī.
choices.english: Eat with the aunt next Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎn yí ge xīngqí zài qù chīfàn.
choices.english: Have the dinner a week later.

questions.why: His first idea was to eat with the aunt too, but once he hears she will be tired, 既然這樣……我們兩個下個星期六再吃 moves the dinner back a week, just the two of them. Eating with the aunt was the idea he dropped.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你昨天怎麼沒來看樂團的表演？我們在門口等了你半個小時。
lines.simplified: 你昨天怎么没来看乐团的表演？我们在门口等了你半个小时。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān zěnme méi lái kàn yuètuán de biǎoyǎn? Wǒmen zài ménkǒu děng le nǐ bàn ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Why didn't you come to the band's show yesterday? We waited for you at the entrance for half an hour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真不好意思。我正要出門去買票的時候，發現廚房淹水了，只好留在家裡把水弄乾淨。
lines.simplified: 真不好意思。我正要出门去买票的时候，发现厨房淹水了，只好留在家里把水弄干净。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bù hǎoyìsi. Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén qù mǎi piào de shíhòu, fāxiàn chúfáng yānshuǐ le, zhǐhǎo liú zài jiālǐ bǎ shuǐ nòng gānjìng.
lines.english: Really sorry. Just as I was about to go out and buy a ticket, I found the kitchen flooded, so I had to stay home and clear up the water.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 票我們早就幫你買好了。那現在沒問題了吧？
lines.simplified: 票我们早就帮你买好了。那现在没问题了吧？
lines.pinyin: Piào wǒmen zǎo jiù bāng nǐ mǎi hǎo le. Nà xiànzài méi wèntí le ba?
lines.english: We'd already bought you a ticket. Is everything all right now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 已經沒事了，就是弄到半夜。下次我一定去。
lines.simplified: 已经没事了，就是弄到半夜。下次我一定去。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng méi shì le, jiùshì nòng dào bànyè. Xià cì wǒ yídìng qù.
lines.english: It's fine now, it just took me till midnight. Next time I'll definitely go.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼沒去看表演？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么没去看表演？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme méi qù kàn biǎoyǎn?
prompt.english: Why didn't the man go to the show?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chūmén qián chúfáng chū le shì.
choices.english: Something went wrong in the kitchen before he left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu mǎi dào biǎoyǎn de piào.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chūmén yǐhòu yòu bèi jiào huí jiā.
choices.english: He was called home after leaving.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Máng dào bànyè tài lèi le.
choices.english: He was worn out from being busy till midnight.

questions.why: 我正要出門……的時候，發現廚房淹水了: 正要 means he had not left yet when the flood stopped him. His friends had his ticket already, and dealing with the water till midnight came after the show had started.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天怎麼搭捷運來公司？腳踏車壞了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么搭捷运来公司？脚踏车坏了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme dā jiéyùn lái gōngsī? Jiǎotàchē huài le ma?
lines.english: How come you took the MRT to the office today? Is your bike broken?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是。我早上正準備騎車出門，就下起大雨來，只好改搭捷運。沒想到比平常早到了二十分鐘。
lines.simplified: 不是。我早上正准备骑车出门，就下起大雨来，只好改搭捷运。没想到比平常早到了二十分钟。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Wǒ zǎoshàng zhèng zhǔnbèi qí chē chūmén, jiù xià qǐ dà yǔ lái, zhǐhǎo gǎi dā jiéyùn. Méixiǎngdào bǐ píngcháng zǎo dào le èrshí fēnzhōng.
lines.english: No. This morning, just as I was getting ready to cycle out, it started pouring, so I took the MRT instead. I never expected to arrive twenty minutes earlier than usual.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 捷運真的比較快。那妳以後都搭捷運吧？
lines.simplified: 捷运真的比较快。那你以后都搭捷运吧？
lines.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhēn de bǐjiào kuài. Nà nǐ yǐhòu dōu dā jiéyùn ba?
lines.english: The MRT really is faster. So you'll take it from now on, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不一定，下雨天才搭。騎車比較自由，還可以運動。
lines.simplified: 不一定，下雨天才搭。骑车比较自由，还可以运动。
lines.pinyin: Bù yídìng, xià yǔ tiān cái dā. Qí chē bǐjiào zìyóu, hái kěyǐ yùndòng.
lines.english: Not necessarily, only on rainy days. Cycling is freer, and I get some exercise too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的今天為什麼搭捷運？
prompt.simplified: 女的今天为什么搭捷运？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jīntiān wèishénme dā jiéyùn?
prompt.english: Why did the woman take the MRT today?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She wanted to get to work earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái méi chūmén jiù xià yǔ le.
choices.english: It rained before she had left.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qí dào yíbàn xià qǐ yǔ lái.

questions.why: 我早上正準備騎車出門，就下起大雨來: 正準備 means she was only getting ready, so the rain came before she left, not halfway. Her bike is fine (不是), and arriving early was a surprise (沒想到).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期六晚上河邊有煙火，我們一起去看吧？
lines.simplified: 这个星期六晚上河边有烟火，我们一起去看吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng hébiān yǒu yānhuǒ, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn ba?
lines.english: There are fireworks by the river this Saturday evening. Shall we go and watch together?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊。煙火八點才開始，我們七點半到就可以了吧？
lines.simplified: 好啊。烟火八点才开始，我们七点半到就可以了吧？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Yānhuǒ bā diǎn cái kāishǐ, wǒmen qī diǎn bàn dào jiù kěyǐ le ba?
lines.english: Sure. The fireworks don't start until eight, so getting there at seven thirty should be fine, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說去年人多得不得了。萬一沒有位子，就什麼都看不到了。我們還是六點就去吧，晚餐到那裡再買。
lines.simplified: 听说去年人多得不得了。万一没有位子，就什么都看不到了。我们还是六点就去吧，晚餐到那里再买。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō qùnián rén duō de bùdéliǎo. Wànyī méiyǒu wèizi, jiù shénme dōu kàn bú dào le. Wǒmen háishì liù diǎn jiù qù ba, wǎncān dào nàlǐ zài mǎi.
lines.english: I hear the crowd last year was huge. If there's no space left, we won't see a thing. We'd better go at six, and buy dinner when we get there.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，那我五點半去妳家找妳。
lines.simplified: 好，那我五点半去你家找你。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ wǔ diǎn bàn qù nǐ jiā zhǎo nǐ.
lines.english: OK, then I'll come to your place at five thirty.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想六點就去？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想六点就去？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng liù diǎn jiù qù?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to go at six?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She wants to eat dinner by the river.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà wǎn dào méi dìfāng kàn.
choices.english: She fears there'll be nowhere to watch if they're late.

questions.why: 萬一沒有位子，就什麼都看不到了。我們還是六點就去吧: the crowd she fears is at the river, not on the road. Buying food there is what they will do once there, not why, and the fireworks start at eight.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳最近週末都在做什麼？找妳出去，妳都說沒空。我還以為妳在打工。
lines.simplified: 你最近周末都在做什么？找你出去，你都说没空。我还以为你在打工。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zhōumò dōu zài zuò shénme? Zhǎo nǐ chūqù, nǐ dōu shuō méi kòng. Wǒ hái yǐwéi nǐ zài dǎgōng.
lines.english: What have you been doing at weekends lately? Every time I ask you out, you say you're busy. I thought you had a part-time job.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 哪有時間打工？不是在家睡覺，就是去補習班上英文課，週末一下子就過去了。
lines.simplified: 哪有时间打工？不是在家睡觉，就是去补习班上英文课，周末一下子就过去了。
lines.pinyin: Nǎ yǒu shíjiān dǎgōng? Bú shì zài jiā shuìjiào, jiù shì qù bǔxíbān shàng Yīngwén kè, zhōumò yíxiàzi jiù guòqù le.
lines.english: Where would I find time for a job? If I'm not sleeping at home, I'm at cram school for English. The weekend is gone in no time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣太累了吧。這個星期天跟我們去看電影吧。
lines.simplified: 这样太累了吧。这个星期天跟我们去看电影吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng tài lèi le ba. Zhège xīngqítiān gēn wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.
lines.english: That sounds exhausting. Come to a movie with us this Sunday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，剛好這個星期天補習班放假。
lines.simplified: 好啊，刚好这个星期天补习班放假。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, gānghǎo zhège xīngqítiān bǔxíbān fàngjià.
lines.english: Sure, the cram school happens to be closed this Sunday.

lines.traditional: 你們班的休閒活動調查做完了嗎？

lines.english: Has your class finished its survey on free-time activities?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 總算做完了！本來以為兩個星期就夠了，結果花了快一個月。我們一共問了一百二十個大學生。
lines.simplified: 总算做完了！本来以为两个星期就够了，结果花了快一个月。我们一共问了一百二十个大学生。
lines.pinyin: Zǒngsuàn zuò wán le! Běnlái yǐwéi liǎng ge xīngqí jiù gòu le, jiéguǒ huā le kuài yí ge yuè. Wǒmen yígòng wèn le yìbǎi èrshí ge dàxuéshēng.
lines.english: Finally finished! I thought two weeks would be enough, but it took almost a month. We asked a hundred and twenty university students.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 結果怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 结果怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What were the results?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 三分之二的人說，週末最常在家用手機、電腦。常去戶外運動的，只有四分之一。
lines.simplified: 三分之二的人说，周末最常在家用手机、电脑。常去户外运动的，只有四分之一。
lines.pinyin: Sān fēn zhī èr de rén shuō, zhōumò zuì cháng zài jiā yòng shǒujī, diànnǎo. Cháng qù hùwài yùndòng de, zhǐyǒu sì fēn zhī yī.
lines.english: Two thirds said that at weekends they are most often at home on their phones and computers. Only a quarter often exercise outdoors.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我還以為最多人在家睡覺呢。那剩下的人呢？
lines.simplified: 我还以为最多人在家睡觉呢。那剩下的人呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐwéi zuì duō rén zài jiā shuìjiào ne. Nà shèngxià de rén ne?
lines.english: I thought most people would be sleeping at home. And the rest?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他們週末都得打工，沒時間休息。
lines.simplified: 他们周末都得打工，没时间休息。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen zhōumò dōu děi dǎgōng, méi shíjiān xiūxí.
lines.english: They all have to work part-time at weekends and have no time to rest.

lines.traditional: 很喜歡，老闆和同事都很好。只是她每個月有三分之一的錢都得付房租。
lines.simplified: 很喜欢，老板和同事都很好。只是她每个月有三分之一的钱都得付房租。
lines.pinyin: Hěn xǐhuān, lǎobǎn hé tóngshì dōu hěn hǎo. Zhǐshì tā měi ge yuè yǒu sān fēn zhī yī de qián dōu děi fù fángzū.
lines.english: She loves it; her boss and colleagues are great. It's just that a third of her money each month has to go on rent.

lines.english: That's not so bad. Half of my brother's money each month goes on rent.

lines.english: That much! Then he should move somewhere cheaper.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 小美，我是張叔叔。妳上次說想學衝浪，這個星期六我剛好有空，可以在海灘教妳。
lines.simplified: 小美，我是张叔叔。你上次说想学冲浪，这个星期六我刚好有空，可以在海滩教你。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎoměi, wǒ shì Zhāng shúshu. Nǐ shàng cì shuō xiǎng xué chōnglàng, zhège xīngqíliù wǒ gānghǎo yǒu kòng, kěyǐ zài hǎitān jiāo nǐ.
lines.english: Xiaomei, it's Uncle Zhang. Last time you said you wanted to learn to surf. I happen to be free this Saturday and can teach you on the beach.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來想約下午，可是那裡下午的風會變得很大，在海裡很危險，所以我們不得不早一點開始，七點就要到海灘。衝浪板妳不用買，我這裡有，只要多帶一套衣服來換就好。
lines.simplified: 我本来想约下午，可是那里下午的风会变得很大，在海里很危险，所以我们不得不早一点开始，七点就要到海滩。冲浪板你不用买，我这里有，只要多带一套衣服来换就好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng yuē xiàwǔ, kěshì nàlǐ xiàwǔ de fēng huì biàn de hěn dà, zài hǎi lǐ hěn wéixiǎn, suǒyǐ wǒmen bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn kāishǐ, qī diǎn jiù yào dào hǎitān. Chōnglàngbǎn nǐ búyòng mǎi, wǒ zhèlǐ yǒu, zhǐyào duō dài yí tào yīfu lái huàn jiù hǎo.
lines.english: I wanted to make it the afternoon, but the wind there gets very strong then and the sea is dangerous, so we'll have to start early: be at the beach by seven. You don't need to buy a surfboard, I have one. Just bring a change of clothes.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 在我教過的學生中，第一天就能站在衝浪板上的人不多，所以學得慢也別擔心。我們星期六見！
lines.simplified: 在我教过的学生中，第一天就能站在冲浪板上的人不多，所以学得慢也别担心。我们星期六见！
lines.pinyin: Zài wǒ jiāo guo de xuéshēng zhōng, dì yī tiān jiù néng zhàn zài chōnglàngbǎn shàng de rén bù duō, suǒyǐ xué de màn yě bié dānxīn. Wǒmen xīngqíliù jiàn!
lines.english: Among the students I've taught, not many can stand on the board on the first day, so don't worry if you learn slowly. See you Saturday!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好。這個月公司要辦一個活動，下個星期六帶大家去山上摘水果。
lines.simplified: 大家好。这个月公司要办一个活动，下个星期六带大家去山上摘水果。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo. Zhège yuè gōngsī yào bàn yí ge huódòng, xià ge xīngqíliù dài dàjiā qù shān shàng zhāi shuǐguǒ.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. This month the company is holding an outing: next Saturday we're taking you all up the mountain to pick fruit.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 本來我們打算跟去年一樣，去餐廳吃飯、唱歌。可是在上個月的調查中，三分之一的同事說週末最想在家睡覺，但是有一半的人希望公司多辦戶外的活動。所以這次我們改去山上。
lines.simplified: 本来我们打算跟去年一样，去餐厅吃饭、唱歌。可是在上个月的调查中，三分之一的同事说周末最想在家睡觉，但是有一半的人希望公司多办户外的活动。所以这次我们改去山上。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái wǒmen dǎsuàn gēn qùnián yíyàng, qù cāntīng chīfàn, chànggē. Kěshì zài shàng ge yuè de diàochá zhōng, sān fēn zhī yī de tóngshì shuō zhōumò zuì xiǎng zài jiā shuìjiào, dànshì yǒu yíbàn de rén xīwàng gōngsī duō bàn hùwài de huódòng. Suǒyǐ zhè cì wǒmen gǎi qù shān shàng.
lines.english: We first planned to do the same as last year: dinner and singing at a restaurant. But in last month's survey, a third of you said what you most want at weekends is to sleep at home, while half said you hope the company will hold more outdoor activities. So this time we're going up the mountain.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那裡的水果很有名，週末去摘的人很多，去晚了，好的就被摘光了。所以我們不得不早一點出發，早上七點就要在公司門口集合。山上離公司不遠，開車一個小時就到了。摘的水果大家可以帶回家。想參加的人，請在星期三以前告訴我。
lines.simplified: 那里的水果很有名，周末去摘的人很多，去晚了，好的就被摘光了。所以我们不得不早一点出发，早上七点就要在公司门口集合。山上离公司不远，开车一个小时就到了。摘的水果大家可以带回家。想参加的人，请在星期三以前告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shuǐguǒ hěn yǒumíng, zhōumò qù zhāi de rén hěn duō, qù wǎn le, hǎo de jiù bèi zhāi guāng le. Suǒyǐ wǒmen bùdébù zǎo yìdiǎn chūfā, zǎoshàng qī diǎn jiù yào zài gōngsī ménkǒu jíhé. Shān shàng lí gōngsī bù yuǎn, kāichē yí ge xiǎoshí jiù dào le. Zhāi de shuǐguǒ dàjiā kěyǐ dài huí jiā. Xiǎng cānjiā de rén, qǐng zài xīngqísān yǐqián gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: The fruit there is famous and lots of people go picking at weekends; get there late and the good fruit has all been picked. So we have no choice but to leave early: meet at the company entrance at 7 a.m. The mountain isn't far from the office, only an hour's drive. You can take the fruit you pick home. If you want to come, tell me before Wednesday.

passage.pinyin: Qùnián dōngtiān, wǒ hé péngyǒu qù Rìběn huáxuě. Wǒ cónglái méi huá guo xuě, yìzhí hěn pà shòushāng, hòulái péngyǒu shuō nàlǐ de jiàoliàn hěn yǒu nàixīn, wǒ cái dāyìng qù. Chūfā qián, nàlǐ yìlián hǎojǐ tiān dōu xià dà xuě. Dì yī tiān wǒmen zhèng yào shàngkè shí, jiàoliàn jiù shuō xuě tài dà le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zài shìnèi děng. Qián liǎng tiān wǒ chángcháng yí zhàn qǐlái jiù dǎo xiàqù, dào le dì sān tiān, wǒ zǒngsuàn néng zìjǐ cóng shān shàng huá xiàlái le, nà zhǒng gǎnjué cìjī de bùdéliǎo. Zhè cì de lǚxíng ràng wǒ kèfú le duì huáxuě de xīnlǐ zhàng'ài. Huí Táiwān yǐqián, péngyǒu shuō: “Jìrán nǐ zhème xǐhuān, míngnián wǒmen jiù zài lái yí cì ba!”
passage.english: Last winter a friend and I went skiing in Japan. I had never skied and was always afraid of getting hurt; then my friend said the coaches there were very patient, and only then did I agree to go. Before we left, it snowed heavily there for several days in a row. On the first day, just as we were about to start our lesson, the coach said the snow was too heavy, so we had to wait indoors. For the first two days I kept falling over as soon as I stood up, but on the third day I could finally ski down the mountain by myself, and it was so exciting. This trip helped me get over my fear of skiing. Before we went back to Taiwan, my friend said, "Since you love it this much, let's come again next year!"

questions.why: 那裡一連好幾天都下大雪: 一連 + a number of days + 都 means "several days in a row". 一直 cannot stand before 好幾天 like this, 從來 needs a negative, and 一起 needs company.

我們正要上課時，教練就說雪太大了: 正要……時 means "just as we were about to"; the coach stopped the lesson at that moment. 剛才 means a moment before now, not a day last winter, 曾經 is for past experience, and 常常 clashes with 第一天.
After two days of not standing up, 到了第三天，我總算能自己滑下來了: 總算 marks the result she worked for. 早就 (long ago) clashes with 第三天, and 還是 would need 不能.
Skiing down alone for the first time, 那種感覺刺激得不得了: it was a thrill, and she loved it enough to come back. 安靜 and 熱鬧 describe a place, not the rush of speeding down, and 溫暖 does not fit a snowy slope.
讓我克服了對滑雪的心理障礙: she was afraid at first and now loves skiing, so she got over the block. 發現 would mean she only found the fear on this trip.
既然你這麼喜歡，明年我們就再來一次吧: 既然 takes a known fact, 就 gives the suggestion. 雖然 needs 可是, 就算 needs 也, and 不管 needs 都.

Bàmā juéde yùndòng hǎo dàoshì hǎo, kěshì pà tā yīnwèi liàn qiú ér méi shíjiān niànshū, suǒyǐ yìzhí bú ràng tā cānjiā bǐsài. Hòulái jiàoliàn lái wǒmen jiā, shuō mèimei hěn yǒu shílì, bàba cái shuō: “Jìrán jiàoliàn dōu zhème shuō le, wǒmen jiù ràng nǐ qù. Búguò, gōngkè yě děi xiě wán.” Wèile niànshū hé liàn qiú, mèimei xīshēng le hěn duō wán de shíjiān, měi tiān bùdébù zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng. Shàng ge xīngqí, tā zhèng yào chūmén qù bǐsài shí, bàmā shuō yào yìqǐ qù tì tā jiāyóu, tā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo.
passage.english: My younger sister has loved basketball since she was little: every day when she gets back from school she is either practising on the court or watching games at home. My parents think sport is good, all right, but they worried that training would leave her no time to study, so they never let her play in games. Then her coach came to our home and said she was really talented, and only then did Dad say, "Since even the coach says so, we'll let you go. But your homework still has to get done." To study and train, my sister gave up a lot of free time, and now she has no choice but to get up at five every morning. Last week, just as she was about to leave for a game, my parents said they would come and cheer for her, and she was thrilled.

questions.why: 每天從學校回來以後不是在球場練球，就是在家看球賽: 不是 A，就是 B means always one of the two. 只要 and 要是 need 就 + a result, and 只有 needs 才.

運動好倒是好，可是怕她……: X 倒是 X grants the point (sport is good) before 可是 turns to the worry. 只是 already means "but" and cannot sit between 好 and 好, 好還是好 is not a pattern, and 好就是好 insists sport is simply good, which the 可是 then fights.
既然教練都這麼說了，我們就讓妳去: 既然 + a fact Dad now accepts (the coach has spoken), 就 + his decision. 不但 needs 而且 or 還, 除了 needs 以外 and 還 or 都, and 只有 needs 才.
妹妹犧牲了很多玩的時間: to fit in study and practice she gave up free time. You overcome a problem and try something new, not free time.
為了念書和練球……每天不得不早上五點就起床: with study and practice both to fit in, she has to get up at five. 不必 and 不再 take the early start away, and 不敢 makes no sense here.

她正要出門去比賽時，爸媽說要一起去: 正要……時, "just as she was about to leave", when her parents spoke up. 再 is for doing something again later, and 還 and 也 need an earlier leaving or someone else leaving to compare with.

Last month I had no choice but to find another place, and I moved somewhere farther from school. Now I spend forty more minutes a day on the road, but I can rest properly at night, and I think it's worth it.

text.traditional: 我爸爸以前在銀行工作。在他心中，工作比什麼都重要，他每天很早出門，很晚才回家，週末也常常犧牲休息的時間去公司。我小時候很少看到他，連生日都是媽媽陪我過的。三年前，爸爸的身體出了問題，醫生說他得少工作一點，要不然身體會越來越差。爸爸不得不離開了銀行。剛開始，他覺得在家裡沒事做，很不習慣。後來他在院子裡種了很多花和蔬菜，每天早上都去看看它們長得怎麼樣。現在一到開花的季節，鄰居都會來我們家看花、聊天。爸爸說，過去他以為只有工作能讓自己快樂，現在才知道，生活中還有很多美好的事。

text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yǐqián zài yínháng gōngzuò. Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu hěn shǎo kàndào tā, lián shēngrì dōu shì māma péi wǒ guò de. Sān nián qián, bàba de shēntǐ chū le wèntí, yīshēng shuō tā děi shǎo gōngzuò yìdiǎn, yàobùrán shēntǐ huì yuè lái yuè chà. Bàba bùdébù líkāi le yínháng. Gāng kāishǐ, tā juéde zài jiālǐ méi shì zuò, hěn bù xíguàn. Hòulái tā zài yuànzi lǐ zhòng le hěn duō huā hé shūcài, měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù kànkan tāmen zhǎng de zěnmeyàng. Xiànzài yí dào kāihuā de jìjié, línjū dōu huì lái wǒmen jiā kàn huā, liáotiān. Bàba shuō, guòqù tā yǐwéi zhǐyǒu gōngzuò néng ràng zìjǐ kuàilè, xiànzài cái zhīdào, shēnghuó zhōng hái yǒu hěn duō měihǎo de shì.
text.english: My father used to work at a bank. In his heart, work mattered more than anything: he left early every day, came home late, and often gave up his weekend rest to go to the office. As a child I rarely saw him; even my birthdays were spent with my mother. Three years ago my father's health went wrong. The doctor said he had to work less, or his health would keep getting worse, and he had no choice but to leave the bank. At first he felt he had nothing to do at home and found it hard to get used to. Then he planted lots of flowers and vegetables in the yard and went every morning to see how they were growing. Now, whenever the flowers bloom, the neighbors come over to look at them and chat. My father says he used to think only work could make him happy; now he knows life holds many other good things.

text.traditional: 我的室友是韓國人，來臺灣念書已經兩年了。她不僅中文說得很好，還很會做菜，做的菜又好看又好吃。每個週末，她都會去市場買菜，順便幫我買一些水果。上個月她媽媽來臺灣看她，送了我一大箱韓國的醬料，說謝謝我照顧她的女兒。我本來以為只有這一箱，沒想到她媽媽回去以後，又從韓國寄了兩箱來，甚至還寫了一封很長的信給我。我覺得很不好意思，因為其實都是她女兒在照顧我：我生病的時候，是她煮東西給我吃；我要去沒去過的地方時，也是她陪我去。

Shàng ge yuè tā māma lái Táiwān kàn tā, sòng le wǒ yí dà xiāng Hánguó de jiàngliào, shuō xièxie wǒ zhàogù tā de nǚ'ér. Wǒ juéde hěn bù hǎoyìsi, yīnwèi qíshí dōu shì tā nǚ'ér zài zhàogù wǒ: wǒ shēngbìng de shíhòu, shì tā zhǔ dōngxi gěi wǒ chī; wǒ yào qù méi qù guo de dìfāng shí, yě shì tā péi wǒ qù.

Now she not only reads the news on her phone, but often chats with an old friend who lives in the US, and once they start they can't stop. Sometimes she's busier than I am.
